description: Improved RBTS Bus 2 test system data for power system reliability assessment and risk management studies is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Kallisthenis Sgouras. The m-file contains an improvement RBTS Bus 2 test system for power system reliability assessment and risk management studies. The topology of the RBTS Bus 2 can be found in the pdf file. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2016. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
